name: Identity recovery benchmark v1
reference: Unchanged publisher personnel-level GT, independent of tested trackers; NOT independently human-verified by this project
seed: Perfect publisher box on first case frame, disclosed manual-selection surrogate; only seed box exposed to future inference

scoring.absence: no output expected; absence is not a recovery success
scoring.uncertain: review uncertainty retained separately; never silently relabel or interpolate
scoring.latency: Elapsed time from first visible miss, wrong/misaligned output or output while absent to the first three consecutive correct frames. None means no recovery within case; event frame is contextual, not used to hide earlier failures.
scoring.wrong_person: output failing target IoU but matching any other publisher ID at IoU>=0.5

reserved_validation.scope: unseen temporal continuation of a previously tested match, NOT an independent-match holdout
reserved_validation.rule: lock candidate code/config before downloading and inspecting this interval; include all 600 frames, no event cherry-picking

split_rule: paired targets share one event group; never split overlapping event groups across development and validation
release: benchmark may be used for development with publisher labels; no claim of independently human-verified ground truth until separate review
